description: A kit containing grinders, presses, molds, and chemical reagents for converting butchered creature parts into taming treats.  This is a crafting tool; to use it, first butcher a creature to collect its meat or parts, then open the crafting menu (press & or search crafting) and look for treat recipes under Other or Electronics.  The toolkit must be in your inventory.  It is never consumed; you can reuse it forever.  Fresh meat makes meaty treats; plant matter makes veggie treats; electronic parts make tech treats; tainted flesh from zombies and nether creatures makes eldritch treats.  Zombies can't be converted into meaty treats because of their tainted nature.
A crude but strong length of braided sinew, skin, and dried tendons.  It's unpleasant to handle, but it works as well as any rope for tying things down or leashing tamed creatures.
